title: Dimension comparison for Student's statistic under symmetric unimodality
summary: Let $q_n(r)$ denote the tail probability at $r$ of the self-normalized sum of $n$ independent centered uniform variables. At $r=3$, the first distribution-sensitive term in the two-sided Edgeworth expansion of Student's statistic vanishes. We evaluate the expansion at the common moving boundary $r_n=3+λ/n$ in dimensions $n$ and $n-k$. Uniformly over deletion ranks retaining a fixed positive fraction of observations, the first nonzero difference converges to an explicit phase surface $H_δ(λ)$; its zero curve unifies fixed, sublinear and fixed-fraction deletions, with tangent crossing $12/35$.…
